datasource_item.source_question_text:
A Chinook salmon can jump out of water with a speed v0 and an angle 𝜃 above the horizontal. What is the speed of the fish when it is at the maximum height?
A. 𝑣0. [incorrect]
B. 𝑣0 cos𝜃. [correct]
C. 𝑣0 sin𝜃. [incorrect]
D. 0. [incorrect]
datasource_item.generated_question_text:
A tennis ball is launched with speed u0 at an angle ϕ above the horizontal.
What is the speed of the ball when it is at its maximum height (neglect air
resistance)?
A. u0. [incorrect] Explanation: This is incorrect because the vertical component decreases to zero at the top, reducing the speed
from its initial value.
B. u0 cos ϕ. [correct] Explanation: This is correct because at maximum height the vertical velocity is zero while the horizontal
component remains u0 cos ϕ.
C. u0 sin ϕ. [incorrect] Explanation: This is incorrect because u0 sin ϕ is the initial vertical component, which is not the speed at the
top.
D. 0. [incorrect] Explanation: This is incorrect because the horizontal component is generally nonzero at the top, so the speed
is not zero.
